references.text: Parallel account where Israel sends messengers to Sihon, king of Heshbon, with a peaceful request to pass through his land
Jephthah refers to this event where Israel sent messengers to Sihon, king of Heshbon, with peaceful words
Similar situation where Israel sends messengers with peaceful intentions, this time to the king of Edom
The Mosaic law's command to offer peace to a city before attacking it, illustrating the principle behind sending a message of peace
Identifies Heshbon as Sihon's city and capital, the same geographical reference as in the Deuteronomy text
